tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: A confirmed close above the broken structure and a successful retest of 71.5 as support.

tracked_patterns.name: Fair Value Gap

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Price has not yet returned to test or fill the detected gap.

tracked_patterns.name: Ascending Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price is testing resistance near 72.5 while forming a series of higher lows around 71.5 to 72.0.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Multiple confirmed touches of both the horizontal resistance and rising support trendline, plus breakout confirmation.

tracked_patterns.name: Double Top

tracked_patterns.name: Triple Bottom

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Pattern is complete; no missing conditions.
